page.head_seo_title: Delivery and returns for chocolate orders
page.meta_description: How we ship our chocolate and how to return an order.
page.content:
Delivery

We ship from Bern every working day. Orders placed before 2 pm leave the same day.

Returns

Not happy? Send the unopened box back within 14 days and we refund the full price. See our contact page for the address.
